They did not borrow for a clothes dryer. They saved for it.

Kevin Trudeau remembers when his parents decided to buy a new dryer. His father taped a label on an old coffee can, and the family dropped in nickels, dimes and quarters.

Kevin even shoveled snow to chip in. Six months later, the can held enough to pay for it.

What is something you waited for, and enjoyed more because you did?
